title: Nice app but pricing is wrong
body:
Could be a great app, but the fact that you can’t set custom timer interval without a paid _subscription_ is absolutely unacceptable.
I understand sub model for cloud services, but paying regularly for an ability to set a shorter break time is ridiculous.
author: phil_gal

title: Technically works
body: The user interface is quite unintuitive. I never know what the numbers (except time) are supposed to represent. Once a week on a random day I sometimes get a random notification telling me to study and I can't find a way to turn that off. The notification count badge stays at 25 and nothing I do makes it go away. Some very basic features, like changing time intervals, are locked behind a paywall. And it sometimes just stops counting the time when in the background. So in summary: I get notifications I don't want or need, and the ones I need I only sometimes get. Even though it technically works sometimes, using a printer is more intuitive.
